title: Return to Steven McFellow

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Oh dear. I fear your swift return spells bad weather for Mr Crogan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh dear. I fear your swift return spells bad weather for Mr Crogan.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm afraid Quince Crogan is the Aseptic's latest victim.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm afraid Quince Crogan is the Aseptic's latest victim.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm afraid Quince Crogan is the Aseptic's latest victim.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm afraid Quince Crogan is the Aseptic's latest victim.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I wasn't able to find him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wasn't able to find him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I wasn't able to find him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I wasn't able to find him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's dead. Suicide.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's dead. Suicide.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Ahhh well. I never did like the man. A means to an end. A sticky end too by the sounds of it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ahhh well. I never did like the man. A means to an end. A sticky end too by the sounds of it.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Well old Quince had many enemies. I'd be surprised if I saw him again the right way up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well old Quince had many enemies. I'd be surprised if I saw him again the right way up.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah I wasn't a fan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah I wasn't a fan.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's pretty insensitive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's pretty insensitive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nicely put.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nicely put.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: It's all an ecosystem. We are just the cells being pushed and pulled through the cities veins. Sometimes the body has to purge the plague. Speaking of which, did you happen to find the NATA-log?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's all an ecosystem. We are just the cells being pushed and pulled through the cities veins. Sometimes the body has to purge the plague. Speaking of which, did you happen to find the NATA-log?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Here it is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here it is.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Oh my, it's good to have you in my hands. Allow me to interface with you... Oh yeah... Yes yes yes... That's good. Of course... Oh my... Wow wow-

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh my, it's good to have you in my hands. Allow me to interface with you... Oh yeah... Yes yes yes... That's good. Of course... Oh my... Wow wow-

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry to interrupt but I'm looking for Huckstash.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry to interrupt but I'm looking for Huckstash.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry to interrupt but I'm looking for Huckstash.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry to interrupt but I'm looking for Huckstash.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Yes! Fine let me just... It's ok... He doesn't know... Yes... Ok... BINGO

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes! Fine let me just... It's ok... He doesn't know... Yes... Ok... BINGO

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Found him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Found him?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Well according to the crew-change data, I'd expect Huckstash and the Crusty Punks to be hanging around the Meridian Market subway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well according to the crew-change data, I'd expect Huckstash and the Crusty Punks to be hanging around the Meridian Market subway.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure thing.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Oh yeah, don't mind him I'm back... Yeah yeah... Ok I'm done. Take it back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh yeah, don't mind him I'm back... Yeah yeah... Ok I'm done. Take it back.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Purge the plague? Pretty bold rhetoric.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Purge the plague? Pretty bold rhetoric.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Purge the plague? Pretty bold rhetoric.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Purge the plague? Pretty bold rhetoric.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Oh you think I could be the mass murderer terrorizing the streets of Nivalis?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh you think I could be the mass murderer terrorizing the streets of Nivalis?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mentioned Aseptic probably knows the the rail network...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mentioned Aseptic probably knows the the rail network...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You mentioned Aseptic probably knows the the rail network...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You mentioned Aseptic probably knows the the rail network...

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Oh you make me laugh. Look I suffer from a crippling anxiety disorder that limits my movements.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh you make me laugh. Look I suffer from a crippling anxiety disorder that limits my movements.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Really?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Yeah it's all uploaded. No way I'm keeping this if it's been near a crime scene. I have enough heat as it is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah it's all uploaded. No way I'm keeping this if it's been near a crime scene. I have enough heat as it is.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ok...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok...

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Leaving the Metro Hub area gives me chronic panic attacks. Why do you think I asked you to go find the Nata-Log?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Leaving the Metro Hub area gives me chronic panic attacks. Why do you think I asked you to go find the Nata-Log?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds rough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds rough.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is it like?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is it like?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ... I could come back?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... I could come back?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Looks like it's gonna have the least amount of CorpSec coverage for a few weeks. That's where I'd be. Now if you don't mind, I'm going to get back to this...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Looks like it's gonna have the least amount of CorpSec coverage for a few weeks. That's where I'd be. Now if you don't mind, I'm going to get back to this...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Meridian Market? You sure?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Meridian Market? You sure?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright.
